scope: Single finite private-output-head invocation, static semi-honest, message-transcript model; all children/files of one logical role belong to that role. Post-exit auditor is outside the online protocol.
validated_software_invariants: Fixed complete real+virtual ID domain; fresh separated AES domains; balanced triple maps; complete BFS matching.
Every selected PIR cell has a full independent bucket/hash mask, including masked out-of-domain sentinel cells.
Fresh BFV public-key zero per response,149bit uniform c0 flood, pinned172bit data-level coefficient modulus.
Every original output row receives an independent fresh final XOR pad after duplicate expansion.
computational_assumptions: SCI static-semi-honest GC/OT security for the actual compiled circuits, with sequential composition.
SEAL BFV IND-CPA and evaluation-key security at the pinned concrete parameters and honest ephemeral key generation.

Rerandomization uses the appropriate seeded-RLWE distribution: the receiver may retain its original key-generation randomness, including any seed used to expand the public mask. Auxiliary keys/query state must not contain the independent fresh rerandomizer secret/error. This needs an explicit reduction/model, not an inference from parameter-table acceptance.
AES PRP security and the actual libraries' entropy/PRNG assumptions; uniform coefficients/pads in the mathematical hybrids model ideal streams.
input_contract: The finite head's public coordinate/norm/rank bounds are those of results/qwen_bounded_head_range_certificate.json; valid frozen model/activation inputs only. No malicious input-validation protocol or general private-backbone provenance claim.
statistical_terms: Keep Hall/capacity/map/PRP-switching events, BFV response simulation, rejection-tail failure and finite model approximation separately identifiable. The single-invocation bounds do not automatically give the same bound for arbitrary-length autoregressive conversations; account for repeated calls explicitly.
unmodeled: Local runtime/microarchitectural/system side channels, malicious deviations, OS isolation on the shared research computer.
Adaptive reuse of an AES key across private query batches; implementation uses fresh keys.
Unbounded generation length with unchanged total statistical budget.
remaining: Independently verify joint simulators, seeded-RLWE/key-generator randomness treatment, abort coupling and full software correspondence; establish independent system contribution and representative task utility. Native tests alone do not discharge these assumptions.
